;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[2019–20 Western Libya campaign]]
***[[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish]]-backed [[Government of National Accord|GNA]] forces enter the strategic [[Libyan National Army]]-held town of [[Tarhuna]], west of [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. The town is considered to be a stronghold for [[Field marshal (Libya)|Field Marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]]. The GNA operations room say its forces have reached the centre of the town. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/libyan-government-says-it-has-entered-haftar-stronghold-tarhouna-idUKKBN23C11Q (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo massacres]] 
**The [[High Commissioner for Human Rights]] of the [[United Nations]], [[Michelle Bachelet]], says that more than 1,300 civilians have been killed in recent months and half a million [[internally displaced person|displaced]] in three [[provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|provinces]] of the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] amid a resurgence of attacks on the civilian population by different armed groups. Bachelet says these attacks "may amount to [[crimes against humanity]] and [[war crime]]s". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/1300-civilians-killed-dr-congo-million-flee-200605091341816.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]], [[Operation Barkhane]]
**The [[France|French]] [[Minister of the Armed Forces (France)|Minister of the Armed Forces]] [[Florence Parly]] says that [[al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb|AQIM]] emir [[Abdelmalek Droukdel]], along with members of his inner circle, had been killed in northern [[Mali]] on 3 June 2020. She also says that French forces had also captured a senior AQIM commander in an operation in May. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52943692 (BBC News)]
*[[List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020]]
**Seven people are killed in an overnight shooting and arson at a residence in [[Valhermoso Springs, Alabama]]. Police believe the incident was a targeted attack, but no suspects are in custody. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/dead-alabama-shooting/story?id=71085699 (ABC News)] [https://www.waff.com/2020/06/05/overnight-shooting-alabama-killed-valhermoso-springs/ (WAFF-TV)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Five people are killed after a [[Cessna 210 Centurion]] crashes near [[Puerto Vallarta]], [[Mexico]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/236717 (Aviation Safety Network)]
*Five people are killed after a [[Piper PA-31T Cheyenne]] crashes in [[Eatonton]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/236713 (Aviation Safety Network)]
*A [[multiple-alarm fire|three-alarm fire]] causes major damage to [[Amazon (company)|Amazon]]'s distribution center in [[Redlands, California]]. Despite the extent of the damage and the collapse of the roof, no injuries are reported as the staff was safely evacuated. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/06/05/us/amazon-redlands-fire-trnd/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Buffalo police shoving incident]]
**57 members of the [[Buffalo, New York|Buffalo]] Police Department's Emergency Response Team resign in protest of the city's decision to suspend two officers after injuring a 75-year-old on Thursday. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/buffalo-police-officers-suspended-allegedly-shoving-75-year/story?id=71089424 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] surpasses the required 1,991 delegates to win the Democratic nomination. He will face off against incumbent [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|general election]] in November. [https://www.npr.org/2020/06/05/869553801/biden-formally-secures-democratic-nomination-while-gaining-steam-against-trump (NPR)]
*[[2020 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election]]
